question: Calculate the duration of each track, classify them as short, medium, or long, output the minimum and maximum time for each kind (in minutes) and the total revenue for each category, group by the category.
sql:
WITH track_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    MIN(Milliseconds) as min_ms,
    MAX(Milliseconds) as max_ms,
    AVG(Milliseconds) as avg_ms
  FROM Track
),
track_classified AS (
  SELECT 
    t.TrackId,
    t.Milliseconds / 60000.0 as duration_minutes,
    s.min_ms,
    s.max_ms,
    s.avg_ms,
    (s.min_ms + s.avg_ms) / 2.0 as short_boundary,
    (s.avg_ms + s.max_ms) / 2.0 as medium_boundary,
    CASE 
      WHEN t.Milliseconds <= (s.min_ms + s.avg_ms) / 2.0 THEN 'short'
      WHEN t.Milliseconds <= (s.avg_ms + s.max_ms) / 2.0 THEN 'medium'
      ELSE 'long'
    END as category
  FROM Track t, track_stats s
),
track_revenue AS (
  SELECT TrackId, SUM(UnitPrice * Quantity) as total_revenue
  FROM InvoiceLine
  GROUP BY TrackId
)
SELECT 
  tc.category,
  MIN(tc.duration_minutes) as min_duration_minutes,
  MAX(tc.duration_minutes) as max_duration_minutes,
  COALESCE(SUM(tr.total_revenue), 0) as total_revenue
FROM track_classified tc
LEFT JOIN track_revenue tr ON tc.TrackId = tr.TrackId
GROUP BY tc.category
ORDER BY tc.category
